Initialize FAIRground database

Source: R/database_initialize.R
databaseInitialize.Rd

Creates the core beFAIR tables in the connected database. Specifically, this function generates the following tables based on their registered codebooks:

Usage

databaseInitialize(
  overwrite_reference = TRUE,
  overwrite_core = FALSE,
  drop_all = FALSE,
  con = NULL
)

Arguments

overwrite_reference

Logical. If TRUE, existing reference tables (HGNC, LUNC) are dropped, recreated, and repopulated with the built-in data. Default is TRUE.

overwrite_core

Logical. If TRUE, the core registry tables (table_script, table_codebook) are dropped and recreated. All existing run history will be lost. Default is FALSE.

drop_all

Logical. If TRUE, all beFAIR-managed tables are dropped before initialization proceeds. Only tables known to beFAIR (core, reference, and codebook-derived data tables) are removed. Default is FALSE.

con

A DBI connection. If NULL, the default connection set by FAIRgroundConnect() is used.

Value

Invisibly returns NULL.

Details

  • table_script

  • table_codebook

  • table_datasource

  • table_dependency

  • table_project

It also creates and populates built-in reference tables:

  • HGNC — HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee gene symbols and CD annotations

  • LUNC — LUCID internal nomenclature mapping FCS parameter descriptions to standard symbols

Table definitions are derived from the internal codebook registry and created using .sqlGenerateTable().

Reference tables (HGNC, LUNC) are expected to be updated regularly as nomenclature evolves. Set overwrite_reference = TRUE to drop and recreate them and re-insert the built-in data.

Core registry tables (table_script, table_codebook, table_dependency, table_project) track ETL history and should only be recreated in exceptional circumstances (e.g. a major schema upgrade). Set overwrite_core = TRUE to do so; this will destroy all existing run history. Use with caution.

Full reset (drop_all = TRUE) drops all beFAIR-managed tables before creating the core tables. Only tables known to beFAIR are affected — core registry tables, reference tables, and any data table registered in a codebook (built-in or custom). Other tables in the database (e.g. from other applications) are left untouched. Implies overwrite_core = TRUE and overwrite_reference = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(beFAIR)
FAIRgroundConnect(drv = RSQLite::SQLite(), dsn = ":memory:")

# First-time setup
databaseInitialize()

# Refresh reference tables with updated nomenclature
databaseInitialize(overwrite_reference = TRUE)

# Schema upgrade (destroys run history)
databaseInitialize(overwrite_core = TRUE)

# Full reset: wipe everything and start from scratch
databaseInitialize(drop_all = TRUE)
} # }
